name: Bazel CUDA
display_title: [JAX] Tighten CPU float64 exp ULP bound from 2.0 to 1.5 for XLA >= 91.

head_commit.message:
[JAX] Tighten CPU float64 exp ULP bound from 2.0 to 1.5 for XLA >= 91.

XLA version 91 switches CPU `exp` to 1-ULP YNNPACK SIMD kernels, bringing CPU `float64` `jax.lax.exp` accuracy within 1.5 ULPs.

Tighten the CPU `float64` bound in `ExpTest` (`test_exp_accuracy` and `test_exp_highest_accuracy`) from 2.0 ULPs to 1.5 ULPs when `xla_version >= 91`, and update the `float64` accuracy table in `docs/accuracy.md`.

PiperOrigin-RevId: 1023762475

name: Bazel CUDA
display_title: Fix jnp.logaddexp.reduce / logaddexp2.reduce when initial has a different dtype

head_commit.message:
Fix jnp.logaddexp.reduce and logaddexp2.reduce when initial has a different dtype

The initial value was passed to lax logaddexp unconverted, which asserts that
both operands have the same dtype. Cast it to the dtype of the reduction result,
as the other reductions do.

head_commit.message:
Fix `NaN` check in `lax.linalg._unpack_conjugate_pairs`.

`w.imag == np.nan` is always `False`, shifting conjugate-pair `cumsum` parity when a `NaN` eigenvalue precedes a complex pair. Use `lax._isnan(w.imag)` instead (matching CPU `UnpackEigenvectors`).

name: Bazel CUDA
display_title: Use np.fromiter when materializing devices for abstract meshes.

head_commit.message:
Use np.fromiter when materializing devices for abstract meshes.

Concretizing an AbstractMesh previously built its NumPy device array via
np.vectorize over np.arange, allocating a temporary index array and
invoking a Python lambda for every device. Iterate the device assignment
directly with a pre-sized np.fromiter call instead.

head_commit.message:
[partitioning] Register passthrough `shard_map_collective_rule` for `custom_vmap_p`.

Register `shard_map_collective_rule=lambda *_, **__: None` on `custom_vmap_p` in
`jax._src.custom_batching`, matching `custom_jvp_call_p` and
`custom_vjp_call_p`. Because `custom_vmap_p` lowers directly via
`mlir.lower_fun(custom_vmap_impl, multiple_results=True)`, returning `None`
delegates explicit-mesh partitioning to the primitives inside `call` instead of
raising `NotImplementedError` under `jax_partitioning=True`.
